extension.description: A netrunner look in calm cyan with pink accents: cut corners, glitch titles and big artwork, with online movie and TV data from TMDb Helper.
extension.news: 0.4.63 - With the cursor on the quick menu icon the quick menu is already shown: Down or OK enters it, Up from its top and Back return to the icon, Left and Right leave it. The player controls no longer hide by themselves while the cursor is in the subtitle, audio or video panel. When the player controls open, the controls appear first and the poster, title and plot follow a moment later.[CR]0.4.62 - The weather tile in the quick menu opens a weather page with the current conditions and the forecast for the next days. The player controls hide by themselves a while after the last key press, 8 seconds by default and 3 to 30 seconds in the new Player settings, and stay while the video is paused. The plot under the title in the player can be switched off.[CR]0.4.61 - The quick menu icon is a plain hamburger. Settings live in one place: the quick menu has a single Settings link to the settings page, which left the top menu and shows a System section with the machine facts and a Settings section with the settings groups.[CR]0.4.60 - On the way back in a cast and crew chain the page no longer shows the focus on its buttons for a second before it jumps to the person: the focus appears on the person once the list is in. During playback the cast row comes back at once, without the chapter row in between.[CR]0.4.59 - Back in a cast and crew chain returns to the person, film or show it was left from, on the same tab, instead of the top of the page. Up from a person opened during playback returns to the cast row on that person, not to the chapter row. An episode page reopened on the way back shows its own show again: the season tabs no longer list every show.[CR]0.4.58 - Down from above skips a row of tabs and lands on its content, Up reaches the tabs: genre rows, cast and crew, search results. Cast and crew tabs switch as soon as the cursor is on them, no OK needed. Episode info pages show resolution, HDR or SDR and the audio track. The skin settings pick the colour scheme. New add-on icon.[CR]0.4.57 - The skin settings open on the main menu, which now comes first and holds the glow switch under Effects. The Effects category and the separate Home pages entry in the settings are gone, Skin leads to the same page.[CR]0.4.56 - Up and Down on the number pad (PIN and number entry) keep the column, like on the keyboard.[CR]0.4.55 - The - and + of a setting with a value range drop their boxes and the pink: the selected sign sits on a small dark chip. The slider knob turns light instead of pink while it moves.[CR]0.4.54 - Down from Play on an episode lands on the episodes, past the season tabs; up from the episodes reaches them.[CR]0.4.53 - The quick menu links (Settings, System, Files) also work over an info page or a TMDb Helper chain: they close it first. The chapter cards show the start time once, under the picture.[CR]0.4.52 - The spotlight fades in on every switch between home and movies, also when both show the same movie. The chapter row shows Kodi's own chapter pictures in full cards when the Jellyfin server has none, instead of short cards without a picture.[CR]0.4.51 - The episode number stands before the title under the picture, where bright pictures no longer hide it. The top menu wraps around: left on home reaches the quick menu icon, right on it home again. A held Home key opens the quick menu also on remotes whose Home key Kodi knows as browser_home or home. The quick menu links the file manager (Files).[CR]0.4.50 - Up and Down on the keyboard keep the column: Down from e lands on d, not on the key that had the focus last in that row.[CR]0.4.49 - First public release. A calm cyberpunk skin for Kodi 21 with configurable home, movies and shows pages, info pages that walk top down, endless cast and crew navigation through TMDb Helper, a search page, a quick menu with clock, weather and power, and a player with track panels, chapter row and cast row.
